suppress.notes: AppAuth for Android is an OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect client. These 2007 findings describe vulnerabilities in the historical OpenID product/server, not this Android client library. Suppress only those two CVEs for the exact AppAuth release scanned.

CVE-2008-7298 describes cookie handling in the historical Android Browser product. The matched dependency is the separate AndroidX Browser / Custom Tabs support library, not that browser application. Keep the correction limited to this exact Maven artifact release.
CVE-2007-4234 affects the unrelated Camera Life photo-hosting product. The dependency is AndroidX CameraX Lifecycle. Suppress only this exact product-name collision for the scanned artifact release.
CVE-2015-3362 affects the Drupal Video module. The matched dependency is AndroidX CameraX Video, which is unrelated to Drupal. Suppress only this exact CVE for the scanned AndroidX artifact release.

kotlinx-coroutines-play-services adapts Kotlin coroutines to Google Play Services Task APIs. Both CVEs describe vulnerabilities in the unrelated Tasks.org Android application, not this JetBrains library. Suppress only these two CVEs for the exact PURL and version scanned.

Dependency-Check interpreted the AndroidX SQLite artifact release number 2.7.0 as the upstream SQLite engine version. These are the AndroidX API and Android-framework adapter artifacts, not the separately bundled SQLite engine. AndroidX documents the framework driver as using Android SDK SQLite APIs and the bundled driver as a distinct artifact. This suppression is restricted to the 39 SQLite CVEs actually reported against these two exact PURLs in this scan. It does not cover sqlite-bundled or other SQLite dependencies. The SQLite implementation supplied by a device's Android OS remains an OS patch-level responsibility outside this Maven dependency scan.

The Firebase Crashlytics scotty-minified.jar was assigned Guava CPEs by filename/product matching. Direct inspection of Crashlytics 21.1.0 found zero com/google/common class entries and zero references to the affected Guava API/type names. Suppress only the three Guava CVEs reported against this exact Crashlytics PURL and version. The app's resolved Guava dependency remains independently pinned and verified at Guava 33.8.0-android in both release runtime graphs.

CVE-2008-0986 targets the BMP parser in obsolete libsgl.so shipped in early Android SDK preview releases, not the modern Google Play Services measurement SDK. This product-identity mismatch is limited to these two exact measurement artifact names.

CVE-2008-3891 applies to the Google Apps SAML Single Sign-On service. The matched artifact is Google Play Services App Set ID SDK, a different product and attack surface. Suppressed only for this exact PURL/CVE pair.
CVE-2012-2055 is a GitHub Enterprise mass-assignment issue. The detector maps it to Glide disklrucache, gifdecoder and core artifacts via an unrelated GitHub CPE. This is not a Glide vulnerability.

CVE-2026-53914 affects the Kotlin Gradle plugin build-cache metadata deserializer, not Kotlin runtime libraries shipped in the app. The Kotlin Gradle plugin is upgraded to 2.4.21 and separately asserted on the build-logic compile classpath in security.yml. This rule is limited to the runtime stdlib/parcelize PURLs reported by the app runtime scan.
